# Luma (لوما)

> Luma (لوما) is a comprehensive Persian-language AI creativity platform providing specialized tools for image generation and editing, video creation and enhancement, speech synthesis, intelligent conversational models, virtual try-on, and visual multi-step workflow automation.

## What Luma Is

Luma is an integrated web platform designed for Persian-speaking creators, designers, developers, and organizations. The platform brings together modern generative and assistive artificial intelligence models into a unified interface, facilitating digital asset creation, media processing, and automated content workflows.

- Route: /
- Route: /about

## Main Capabilities

The platform provides a suite of creative AI capabilities across multiple media modalities:

- Image Generation: Generating high-resolution digital artwork and illustrations from natural language text prompts.
- Image Editing: Modifying existing images with text instructions, including object removal and targeted visual adjustments.
- Background Removal: One-click isolation of subjects with precise edge detection for product photos and design assets.
- Image Upscaling: Enhancing resolution, recovering fine details, and reconstructing image clarity.
- Video Generation: Generating video clips from text prompts, reference images, and animation drivers.
- Video Enhancement: Upscaling video resolution, stabilizing frame rates, and improving visual clarity.
- Text-to-Speech: Synthesizing natural, professional speech from Persian and multilingual text.
- Virtual Try-On: Simulating garments and outfits on digital models for fashion and retail applications.
- Smart Chat: Conversational interactions with advanced language models for ideation, writing, and coding assistance.
- Smart Assistant: Specialized conversational agents trained on custom documentation to provide round-the-clock support.
- Workflows: Visual canvas for chaining multiple AI steps, models, and transformations into repeatable pipelines.

## Services

Luma features eleven core service modules available within the application:

- Image Generation (ساخت تصویر) - Text-to-image creation across diverse artistic styles. Route: /service/img-gen
- Image Editing (ویرایش تصویر) - Inpainting, object replacement, and prompt-based adjustments. Route: /service/img-edit
- Background Removal (حذف پس‌زمینه) - Automated subject cutout and transparent background export. Route: /service/bg-remove
- Smart Assistant (دستیار هوشمند) - Knowledge-grounded virtual assistant for customer support. Route: /service/assistant
- Video Generation (ساخت ویدیو) - Motion and cinematic scene synthesis from text and image prompts. Route: /service/video
- Video Enhancement (افزایش کیفیت ویدئو) - Video upscaling, detail restoration, and frame rate optimization. Route: /service/video-enhancement
- Text-to-Speech (تبدیل متن به گفتار) - Natural audio generation for Persian and multilingual scripts. Route: /service/text-to-speech
- Image Upscaling (افزایش کیفیت تصویر) - Super-resolution enhancement for compressed or legacy images. Route: /service/upscale
- Virtual Try-On (پوشاندن لباس) - Virtual apparel fitting on user-selected models. Route: /service/try-on
- Smart Chat (چت هوشمند) - Comprehensive text generation, inquiry answering, and dialogue. Route: /service/chat
- Workflows (ورک‌فلوها) - Node-based visual orchestration for end-to-end AI processes. Route: /service/workflow
- Services Catalog (خدمات و ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی) - Complete directory of platform tools. Route: /services

## Pricing and Subscription

Luma offers flexible access models tailored to individuals, studios, and enterprise organizations:

- Credit-Based Usage: Users allocate credits toward specific computational tasks across image, video, voice, and language models.
- Subscription Plans: Structured monthly and annual tiers providing bundled credits, higher concurrency, and access to advanced capabilities.
- Transparent Management: Usage quotas, model pricing matrices, and active subscriptions are managed directly within the user account.
- Route: /pricing
- Route: /subscription

## Documentation and Tutorials

Luma maintains educational and technical resources to assist users in integrating and operating platform tools:

- Technical Documentation: API specifications, integration guidelines, and model parameter descriptions. Route: /docs
- Tutorials: Step-by-step practical guides demonstrating workflow creation, prompting techniques, and media post-processing. Route: /tutorials
- Showcase Gallery: Curated examples of community and platform creations with associated generation prompts. Route: /gallery

## Blog and Knowledge Content

The Luma blog provides timely articles, technical insights, and creative best practices regarding generative AI:

- Content Focus: In-depth guides on model selection, prompting strategies, and industry applications.
- Dynamic Publishing: Articles and learning resources are published dynamically through the platform's content service.
- Integrity Standard: Article details, authorship, and publication dates are rendered directly from live application data.
- Route: /blog
